name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px solid ring at 5:1 contrast with no glow or animation. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA for focus visibility while avoiding motion that could trigger vestibular disorders. The trade-off is slightly less visual prominence than a glow, but it keeps the focus ring consistent and predictable for all users.

name: Reader
text: The 4px solid ring still risks crowding small buttons on mobile—especially when users zoom or have fat fingers. A 2px ring with a slow 200ms fade-in meets reduced-motion needs and stays visible without shrinking touch targets. Test with real users at 200% zoom to settle it.
